# Forge peak-anon sampling — lenovinha, 2026-09-03

Raw samples behind 981-n5vx's evidence event. Every 2s through a real
`cargo build --release -p tillandsias-headless` (2m21s, offline) inside a
throwaway container using the forge image, the forge's hardening flags,
its tmpfs caps (/tmp 256m, /run/user/1000 64m) and pids-limit 4096.

Host: Ryzen 7 5800H, 16 threads, 13.8 GiB RAM, 8 GiB swap, native podman.

PEAK anon = 1677 MiB. That is the number; see the event for why
`shmem` in this csv is a confound (the agent scratchpad is tmpfs, so
CARGO_TARGET_DIR lived on tmpfs — a real forge builds onto disk).

There is no `anon.peak`, which is why sampling is the only way to get
this: `memory.peak` is a peak of the composite (anon + page cache) and
cannot be decomposed after the fact.
